status: declared by the pull request that closes #545 before any score was computed; the projection rule, its flows, the fixed constants and the logistic below are the directive's mechanism, written down once. Only the logistic's coefficients are fitted. Nothing here is tuned on a scored day.
mechanism: Roll the latest as-of reserves forward to the scored day T = d + h through every flow public at the decision row d, then place the projected level on the demand curve of NY Fed Staff Report 1019 and forecast P(pressure on T) with a logistic in the projected distance to satiation and its change over the window. It forecasts every day.

columns.net_settlement_ahead_{k}d: k = 1 to 5: the announced net Treasury cash settlement (metadata/net_settlement.json, repo_model.net_settlement) of the k business days after row d, summed, each auction counted from its announcement as at the declared instant on d. Built by repo_model.projected_reserves.ahead_columns.
columns.proj_reserves_h{h}: h = 1 to 5: reserves projected to the scored day d + h, USD billions (below)
columns.proj_dist_h{h}: h = 1 to 5: 100 * (proj_reserves_h / bank_total_assets - satiation), percentage points of bank assets above the satiation level; negative is below the steep part's start
columns.proj_change_h{h}: h = 1 to 5: 100 * (proj_reserves_h - the as-of reserve level) / bank_total_assets, percentage points, the projected change over the window from the reserves observation to the scored day

availability: Every column is a function of the as-of reads at row d's own 16:00 decision and of nothing later: the reserve level, the daily TGA, the ON RRP balance and bank assets are read through the as-of rule (asof.InformationRule at horizon 1, scored row d + 1), and the flows ahead are announcements dated on or before d. repo_model.projected_reserves.check_no_future rebuilds a row from the panel cut at d and refuses (LookAheadError) a column that differs. The columns are declared as a source of their own with a zero lag (metadata/sources_measurement.json, projected_reserves_columns), and are off in every published declaration.

projection.start: R_O: reserve_balances as read at row d (the H.4.1 Wednesday level, weekly carry), observed on the Wednesday O on or before the read row; bank_total_assets as read at d.
projection.to_decision_row: R_d = R_O - (TGA_read - TGA_O) - (RRP_read - RRP_O) - the net settlement announced for the rows after the TGA's read row up to d. The Fed liability identity: what the Treasury account or the facility gains, reserves lose. TGA is tga_daily (Daily Treasury Statement), RRP is on_rrp; the level at O is the same series' value on O, which was public by the time its later read was.
flows_after_d: net Treasury settlements as announced: net_settlement_ahead_{h}d

expected tax receipts on tax dates: for a day x with tax_date = 1, the TGA's rise on the same position in the previous year's window (the deadline of the same month a year earlier, data.corporate_tax_deadline, plus the same number of business days) less that day's net settlement, floored at 0, scale 1; 0 when that row has no TGA change

SOMA runoff: not added. The Treasury leg is already inside the announced net settlement, because the Treasury finances what the Federal Reserve redeems under its caps with a larger public offering (offering_amt) while the maturing estimate excludes the SOMA's holdings (metadata/net_settlement.json, inputs.soma); adding the cap again would count it twice. Agency MBS paydowns are in no tracked series and are not projected.
TGA path: no announced path (refunding or borrowing estimate) is tracked, so the declared persistence rule applies: no flow beyond the settlements and the tax receipts above.
projection.buffer: ON RRP absorbs a net drain before reserves do: F = the sum of the flows after d; reserves fall by F - min(max(F, 0), on_rrp_read), and rise by -F when F is negative.
projection.satiation_source: scarcity.SATIATION_BAND, its lower end (about 12 percent of bank assets)

model.form: ml.pressure_logistic_exceedance: a logistic of spread > tau on the as-of spread, proj_dist_h{h}, proj_change_h{h} and the three pressure-day-type indicators (quarter_end, month_end, tax_date), standardized, with ml.PRESSURE_LOGISTIC_SETTINGS. Six slopes and an intercept, fitted walk-forward on the judge's cadence.
model.expected_signs: proj_dist negative (less reserve, more pressure); proj_change negative (a larger projected fall, more pressure)

combined_row: risk_gbm+projected: the risk-date passer risk_gbm's forecast on every day it is nonzero (a risk date), this model's probability on every day the passer leaves at 0. A measurement beside #539's hurdle; #539 has not merged, so risk_gbm is the passer, and the row can be re-run on #539's code once it has.
projection_error: For every scored day that is a Wednesday (the H.4.1 level is observed on Wednesdays), the projected level of the day, proj_reserves_h{h}, against the reserve level the H.4.1 reports for that Wednesday, by horizon: mean error, mean absolute error and root mean square error in USD billions, beside the error of carrying the as-of level forward unchanged. The realised level is a label read after the fact, as every score reads its labels; it is not a feature.
ceiling: 12 of 26 onsets at any single horizon of 2 or more, the risk-date passers' best (docs/pivot/desk-standard.md section 4): the recall of each row at h = 2 to 5 is reported against it

reports.judge: the judge as declared under the weighted rule in force: tier 1 pooled and per lead, tiers 3 and 5, for the two rows beside the five risk-date passers, ngboost_laplace and the two benchmarks; Brier score and log loss; onset recall by calendar year (2018, 2020 and 2024 called out) from the 26 onsets; onsets warned at each horizon
reports.paired: each row against risk_gbm, ngboost_laplace, calendar_climatology and persistence_logistic at +5 bp: the Brier difference at h = 1 to 5 and the onset recall difference, pooled and by regime and pressure-day type, 90% stationary-bootstrap intervals on shared resamples, the judge's seed

unchanged: the judge, its bar, its cut-off rule, the weighted miss rule in force, the bootstrap, every published declaration, the information set and the lockbox. A measurement only: nothing is published and no day after 2025-12-31 is read (docs/decisions/lockbox.md); the columns are built for scored days to 2025-12-31 only.
